authority: explicit caller request within the same live WASM transaction; no signed origin or host ledger authority

scope.baseline: stateful multi-input ProgramBundle snapshot, maximum 16 MiB, exact expected program identity and checkpoint SHA-256 required
scope.fixed_contract: slot count and external input port declarations remain unchanged
scope.candidate: fresh isolated registry imported from baseline snapshot, edited and compiled with Burn; failed staging never changes the live registry
scope.verification: verifyCases runs MultiInputVerificationCases against the internal baseline snapshot and staged candidate; only an equivalent receipt is retained for promotion
scope.promotion: commitByReceipt requires authorize=true, the exact receipt digest issued by this transaction, unchanged expected baseline identity and stateful bundle bytes, and an unchanged staged candidate; import is atomic
scope.receipt_scope: observed inputs and tolerances only; caller decides whether this evidence is sufficient

invalidation: any successful edit invalidates the staged candidate and prior receipt; staging invalidates a prior receipt even when the new stage fails
promotion_result: new CompiledMultiInputGraph bound to the newly installed registry; old compiled graph remains bound to the old baseline
